speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin
text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth as this year marks the 100th anniversary of Mr Lee Kuan Yew’s birth, whether there are plans to observe the anniversary, and to reflect on his contributions and the values he had stood for.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: They felt it was important to remember Mr Lee’s contributions to Singapore and the ideals that he represented.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: They especially wanted to raise awareness of Mr Lee’s contributions amongst Singaporean youths, many of whom were very young or not yet born when Mr Lee stepped down from the Cabinet.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: Education was a cause dear to Mr Lee’s heart and they felt the fund would be a fitting tribute to him.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: The Government is working with these parties to coordinate these efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: We welcome these ground up initiatives and the spirit in which they have been conceived.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: On the Government’s part, some agencies have planned initiatives for this year, in which Mr Lee will feature.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: The respective agencies will announce more details in due course.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: As Prime Minister Lee said in his April 2015 Parliamentary Statement, how we honour Mr Lee Kuan Yew “must be faithful to the ideals he lived by and fought for”.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: Efforts to mark the 100th anniversary of Mr Lee Kuan Yew’s birth should, as the hon Member Mr Sitoh said, serve to remind us of the values Mr Lee stood for and the ideals he and his fellow founding leaders fought for.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: Through such efforts, we hope that a new generation of Singaporeans will be inspired and continue the work of our Pioneer and Merdeka generations in nation building.
